description: Open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop in pure Rust: layers, masks, adjustment layers, type, vectors, brushes and real PSD files
notes: The portable build ships 'portable.txt' beside photocraft.exe, which switches on PhotoCraft's portable mode: preferences, brush presets, crash-recovery autosaves, the GPU startup marker and logs all live in a 'PhotoCraftData' folder next to the executable. Scoop junctions that folder to '$persist_dir\PhotoCraftData', so the data survives 'scoop update'.

With the PHOTOCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR environment variable set to a non-empty path, PhotoCraft uses that directory instead and this persist location is bypassed; while it is unset, nothing is written to %APPDATA%\Photocraft.
The first install copies an existing %APPDATA%\Photocraft (left by the MSI or by a plain portable copy) into the persist folder, and the pre-uninstall hook mirrors it back as a safety copy.
The portable zip does not register the '.pcraft' file association or the PSD/PSB 'Open with' entries that the MSI installer adds.
PhotoCraft has no built-in updater; use 'scoop update photocraft' so the install and this manifest stay in sync.
pre_install: abort 'PhotoCraft is running, so %APPDATA%\Photocraft cannot be copied into Scoop persist safely. Quit PhotoCraft, then run the install again.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while copying '$legacy' to '$target'; compare the two directories before relying on the new location." } else { info "Copied '$legacy' to '$target'." }
pre_uninstall: warn 'PhotoCraft is running, so the state was not mirrored back to %APPDATA%\Photocraft. Quit it and uninstall again if you want that safety copy.'

if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while mirroring '$data' back to '$legacy'." } else { info "Mirrored '$data' back to '$legacy': a plain portable copy or the MSI installer reads that path, while this Scoop install uses the portable marker." }
